subject.title: Heartbeat skipped reason 'target-none' is misleading when delivery is disabled by default

question: Should disabled heartbeat delivery preserve the machine reason `target-none` and add a human-readable hint/status rendering, or should the machine reason itself be renamed?
rationale: The source repro is clear, but the permanent diagnostic contract affects a machine-readable event field that may be consumed outside the repo.

options.title: Add hint and keep reason
options.body: Preserve `reason: "target-none"` and add an optional operator-facing hint/status rendering such as `delivery disabled by configuration`.

options.title: Rename the reason
options.body: Change the machine reason to a clearer value such as `delivery-disabled`, accepting compatibility risk for existing parsers.

options.title: Leave as-is
options.body: Keep current output and rely on docs/troubleshooting, leaving the reported UX friction unresolved.

recommendation.title: Add hint and keep reason
recommendation.body: Preserve `reason: "target-none"` and add an optional operator-facing hint/status rendering such as `delivery disabled by configuration`.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the default `target: "none"` behavior and has the strongest current history across heartbeat routing and status output.
